commits.message: CollageMaker: prevent panel swap during multi-touch gesture — 12 unit tests, 6 integration tests

notes: Committed pre-staged changes for PanelSwap/MultiTouchHandler coordination. Bug fix: moved dragSourceId from PanelSwap closure to shared state so MultiTouchHandler can clear it at gesture start/cancel, preventing unintended panel swaps during two-finger gestures. Added _multiTouchGestureActive early-exit in PanelSwap._onPointerMove. 12 new unit tests (MultiTouchHandler + PanelSwap) and 6 integration tests (cross-handler coordination). Excluded .DS_Store, MacNotes.txt, TaxBracketVisualizer/References/, and test-results/ from workspace root.
